new online booking system is the pits. After the online booking system kept refreshing itself, I had to physically to go in today to ask to book an appointment for my 2.5 year old. I was then told to wait for a phone call, 4 hours later I missed it within seconds. I Tried to call back asap, no option and there was no other call back from the surgery after that.
So I tried to rebook online straight after work, but you can only fill in the form during surgery open hours, which warns of a 48hr potential response from the reception - not the doctor.
